SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro.en: That's as far as you'll go!

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.en: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro.en: I am one of the four ONYBRIS\nBROTHERS!
SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro.fr: Je suis l'un des quatre FRÈRES\nONYBRIS !

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.en: I'll leave you up to my brothers.

SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle.en: So, what do you think of HEMATEK\nBUILDING's maze?
SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle.fr: Alors, qu'est-ce que tu penses du\nlabyrinthe du BÂTIMENT HEMATEK ?

SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools.en:
TEAM ONYBRIS's BOSS is terribly
cruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to
be used.\pWhat will happen if that tyrant
takes over our company…
SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools.fr:
Le BOSS de la TEAM ONYBRIS est
terriblement cruel !\pPour lui, les POKéMON sont que
des outils.\pQu'est-ce qui se passera si ce
tyran prend le contrôle de notre\lsociété…

SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished.en: I wonder if HEMATEK is finished…
SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished.fr: Je me demande si HEMATEK est\nfinie…
